immutable_intent: Forecast fields are append-only and must never be edited after publication. Results belong in a separate review artifact.

model_policy.promotion: No automatic promotion. Research must beat the production model prospectively on probability and error metrics before a reviewed code change.

schedule_results.name: ESPN public scoreboard (unofficial)
schedule_results.status: undocumented; may change or block automated requests

v9_player_rotation.name: NBA Stats-derived pregame player logs via repository V9 builder

injuries.name: Availability source for V18 audit
injuries.effect: V18 checks current-roster and injury provenance; Elo/V9 model outputs are not recomputed from this audit

review_protocol.played_rule: Score only provider-listed players with minutes > 0; DNP and absent rows are excluded, never zero-filled.

explanation.attribution_note: Linear model contributions explain the fitted margin numerically. Correlated inputs mean they are not causal impact estimates. Historical player availability was inferred, not officially verified.

v18_roster_integrity.reason: No V18 roster-first probability model has yet passed prospective validation

v18_roster_strength.label: V18 active-roster impact proxy · NOT a win probability or projected score
v18_roster_strength.source: NBA.com active-roster IDs + pregame inferred player impact and minutes
v18_roster_strength.limitation: Individual impact proxy and minute reallocations are unvalidated; do not combine this number with Elo without walk-forward calibration
